title: Models and Analyses — a KIND app organized by project and arc
review_protocol: Written single-pass in Draft Mode on 2026-09-23. Chris edits fullprompt.md in place, annotating with (CSH - ...) or (CSH : ...) markers; /ai-design --review kind-model-analysis-explorer-v1 diffs the working tree against draft_commit, classifies every hunk, propagates decision changes through body, stories, testing decisions and taskplan, re-derives the Gotchas section, and recommits with a fresh baseline. The PRD may not advance to ready until review_rounds >= 1.

hard_external_dependency.why: Two PRDs designed in parallel share one project/arc layer. It must be built exactly once. Chris stated on 2026-09-23 that the annotation app will likely be built first, so that PRD owns creation and this one consumes.
hard_external_dependency.blocks: Every task in this taskplan. Nothing here is dispatchable until kbutillib.koros_arc_store is on KBUtilLib main.
interface_this_prd_is_written_against: KorosArcStore.record_analysis(project, arc, rec) — idempotent on record_id
AnalysisRecord(record_id, kind, created_at, producer, subject, status, artifacts, payload)
hard_external_dependency.seam_that_must_not_change: an opaque `payload` dict under a NAMESPACED `kind` string; names may move, the seam may not

coordination.exchange: Sibling proposed a three-part read-only seam (resolve root / enumerate arcs / list analysis records). This session corrected it: there is no write side, so a reader over records nothing emits returns empty. Reply sent 2026-09-23 13:52Z adding the record_analysis half and the namespaced-kind convention.

key_findings_2026_09_23.levels_3_and_4_already_exist: EscherUtils.create_fitness_dashboard (escher_utils.py:1498, builder fitness_dashboard.py) already renders the five tabs plus a fitness-class-recoloured Escher map with condition and FVA dropdowns; create_map_html2:1408 renders flux with class overlays and numerical badges. This PRD delegates to both and builds no rendering.
key_findings_2026_09_23.the_join_key_does_not_exist: Neither producer repo records project or arc on anything. Verified by grep, not assumed.
key_findings_2026_09_23.kind_supplies_the_arc_to_sessions: king_backend/session.py:779 and :865 inject KOROS_ARC into every spawned session. The value is an arc SLUG (koros_start.py:454, test_start.py:134), not a path.
key_findings_2026_09_23.kbdl_jobs_cannot_read_it: KBDL jobs run server-side where KOROS_ARC is absent or wrongly inherited, so the arc travels as an explicit JobContext parameter.
key_findings_2026_09_23.object_store_is_closed: ObjectMetadata (store.py:57) deliberately withholds fields; its docstring says adding one would be 'a deliberate act' and two test files assert the published payload is unchanged. The join cannot live there.
key_findings_2026_09_23.clearinghouse_has_no_model_entity: clearinghouse-lake-1d defines fifteen tables over genome/protein/gene/function/ontology_term. No model or reaction type. Models are not lake rows.
key_findings_2026_09_23.arcs_are_git_repos: runs/genome-clearinghouse/arcs/mag-integration-arc contains .git and .gitignore, so an index sidecar dirties the scientist's tree unless gitignored.
key_findings_2026_09_23.provenance_fields_are_empty_in_practice: inputs [], tool_versions {}, compute_targets [] on the live arc inspected.
key_findings_2026_09_23.fitness_vocabulary_is_already_fixed: essential / active / unused / blocked (+forward/reverse) at fitness_dashboard.py:34-40; concordance computed at :165. Adopted rather than redefined.

external_research.bears_on: Q1 (record schema — question C asks whether RO-Crate or an MLflow-style index is the standard envelope) and Q3 (question A, Escher web-embedding gotchas)
external_research.honest_note: Dispatched BEFORE authoring began, per the research split; returned mid-draft and folded before commit. The Research Report quality section states which recommendations were accepted and which declined, and why.
external_research.verdict: Build it: 'No existing open-source tool provides the exact PROJECT -> ARC -> multi-model drill-down with Escher overlays and fitness agreement as described.'
recommendations_accepted: JSONL failure modes and mitigations: O_APPEND, advisory lock, single-write lines, tolerate truncated final line, last-writer-wins on record_id; SQLite/duckdb past a few MB or thousands of records
Escher: sandboxed iframe needs BOTH allow-scripts and allow-same-origin; do not embed multi-MB map JSON in the payload; enable_search=false on large maps
Agreement metric: confusion matrix with MCC, precision, recall (Q14)
recommendations_declined: RO-Crate as the record envelope -- declined in Q1: PROVENANCE.json already describes the arc, and RO-Crate describes a crate rather than an append-many log of runs
Cross-model ID harmonization via MNXref/BiGG -- unnecessary: create_fitness_dashboard already keys purely on ModelSEED reaction ids and is documented cross-genome
Instantiating escher.Builder ourselves -- we delegate rendering entirely

open_questions_summary.second_highest: Q7 -- record identity collapsing re-runs to one row. Medium confidence; an argument exists that re-runs are themselves interesting.

The external scan's generic lock+O_APPEND answer was insufficient for this fleet.

storage_backend.decided: per-user local database in the pod home directory, written by KBUtilLib's KBDL client utilities; on by default on pods, configurable elsewhere
storage_backend.authority: Chris, 2026-09-23, verbatim: 'I like the idea of kbdl client creating a local database (optionally configurable with PODs having it on by default) and keeping enough data in the database to make the dashboard for genome annotations and models easy to load BUT does NOT have TOO many rows (meaning genome gene level and reaction level data should be JSON blobs rather than SQL tables.'
storage_backend.why_it_binds_this_prd: the instruction names 'the dashboard for genome annotations AND MODELS' and names REACTION-LEVEL data, which is this PRD's domain rather than the annotation twin's. It reached this session as a relay from 1f49b595; the quote itself is what makes it binding, not the relay.
storage_backend.supersedes: the per-arc .analyses/*.jsonl sidecar decided earlier in this same draft
